nodes.label: Observability Interface
nodes.rationale: First-party abstraction for telemetry backend, not direct Sentry API, enabling future OpenTelemetry swap without touching call sites.

nodes.label: SentryObservability Adapter
nodes.rationale: Concrete Sentry implementation of Observability interface; uses Zone-based span propagation instead of Sentry's mutable Scope to support concurrent independent root operations.

nodes.label: NoopObservability
nodes.rationale: Default no-op implementation used during local dev (DSN empty), in unit tests, and fail-soft when SentryFlutter.init throws; ensures no span creation against half-initialized SDK.

nodes.label: TracingHttpClient
nodes.rationale: Injects W3C traceparent header into Supabase requests for correlation; native platforms only (web CORS constraint); created before Supabase.initialize so ambient span is visible to SDK internals.

nodes.label: W3C traceparent Header
nodes.rationale: Standard correlation mechanism for linking client-side Sentry traces to Supabase Cloud log entries; manually constructed from Sentry span IDs because Sentry SDK emits its own sentry-trace header, not the W3C standard.

nodes.label: Dart Zone-based Span Propagation
nodes.rationale: Propagates active span through dedicated Zone per async call tree instead of Sentry's global mutable Scope; prevents concurrent root traces' child spans from attaching to each other's transactions; accepted consequence is SDK scope-based linkage for unhandled errors (fallback to throwable-span association still works).

nodes.label: PII Redaction Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Recursive scrub of span/breadcrumb data before SDK submission; layered (sendDefaultPii=false, key allowlist, string rules for JWTs/URLs/credentials, truncation); ChordPro/lyrics/business content explicitly exempt; no tokens/credentials/emails reach Sentry.

nodes.label: Root Traces = Business Operations
nodes.rationale: Song catalog refresh anchors as one root trace; Drift and Supabase operations become child spans under it; pinned to private _refreshCatalog (not public wrapper) to avoid duplicate root for coalesced callers; prevents instrumenting every use case in this slice (deferred).

nodes.label: Error Reporting Semantics
nodes.rationale: Unhandled errors captured by FlutterError.onError/PlatformDispatcher.onError automatically; handled errors require explicit captureException calls; trace linkage is partial (scope-based route disabled by design, fallback via throwable association); accepted gap prevents cross-attachment bugs under concurrent root operations.

nodes.label: Fail-Soft Bootstrap Pattern
nodes.rationale: If SentryFlutter.init throws (malformed DSN, etc), error reported via FlutterError.reportError, app continues with NoopObservability; no telemetry failures crash the app; mirrors optional-infrastructure pattern rather than fail-fast SupabaseConfig pattern.

nodes.label: SentryConfig
nodes.rationale: Mirrors SupabaseConfig dart-define pattern but fails soft; DSN and environment read from build environment; empty DSN gates SentryFlutter.init.

nodes.label: Android ANR Detection
nodes.rationale: ANR (app not responding) disabled by default in sentry_flutter 8.14.2; explicitly set anrEnabled=true in initObservability; native crash capture via bundled native SDKs ships now, readable symbolication deferred to Phase 9.

nodes.label: Web traceparent CORS Constraint
nodes.rationale: traceparent not CORS-safelisted; on web, injecting it forces preflight; TracingHttpClient gates header injection to !kIsWeb; web correlation deferred until Supabase CORS behavior verified.

nodes.label: Local Data Durability Contract
nodes.rationale: Enforces ADR-020 non-destructive session policy and ADR-008 local-first principle; once synced, catalog stays readable offline forever until explicit purge via one of four enumerated reasons; acceptance: offline Android tablet cold-start shows full catalog, forever.

nodes.label: Four Purge Reasons
nodes.rationale: userSignOut (no confirmation), accountDeleted, differentUserSignIn (dialog if pending work), membershipRevokedConfirmed (two online confirmations + optional dialog); everything else forbidden (null-session events, token expiry, empty responses, single verifiedEmpty, write exceptions, cold-start phases).

nodes.label: LocalDataLifecycle Gate
nodes.rationale: Single seam through which all purges (deleteCatalogsForUser, deletePlanningDataForUser, identity clear) and evictions must pass; requires PurgeReason enum; architecture test enforces no other call site exists; every operation writes audit record.

nodes.label: LastKnownIdentity
nodes.rationale: Persistent single row (rowId=1) holds userId, organizationId, membershipRevokedAt marker; read synchronously before stream subscription goes live; serializes all identity mutations globally; survives process restart so second confirmation can arrive on cold start.

nodes.label: Membership Revocation Two-Confirmation Gate
nodes.rationale: D5: empty membership from current_organization_ids() sets marker; second confirmation (60s monotonic cooldown) + no pending work (or user confirms) = purge with membershipRevokedConfirmed reason; first false confirmation does not destroy data; read-only quarantine dropped permanently.

nodes.label: Offline-Authenticated Mode
nodes.rationale: D3: SongCatalogController reads from local database in sessionExpired state when LastKnownIdentity snapshot exists; no network call, no session check; user stays offline-authenticated, can read and edit, sync resumes after re-auth; non-destructive to ADR-020.

nodes.label: Storage Eviction Mechanism
nodes.rationale: D6: separate from purge; triggered only by storage-exhaustion signals (SQLITE_FULL, disk I/O error, QuotaExceededError) or measured footprint > 2GB budget; evicts least-recently-read, proportionate to pressure; marks snapshot sourcesEvicted for next online refresh; never removes what purge would not.

nodes.label: Blue/Green Snapshot Strategy
nodes.rationale: D4: new rows written under snapshotVersion+1, reads follow active-version pointer, old version deleted after pointer moves; explicit guarantee for web (IndexedDB lacks transactional scope); empty response rejects (implausible-empty status, audit record), second confirmation required.

nodes.label: ADR-020 Non-Destructive Session Policy
nodes.rationale: Local data destroyed only on explicit sign-out or authoritative membership revocation, never on connectivity-driven or unknown session loss; this contract enforces the policy as an invariant rather than individually-correct branches.

nodes.label: ADR-028 Storage Budget and Eviction
nodes.rationale: Scoped eviction to one thing given up under storage pressure; this contract amends it to make trigger establish actual storage pressure and deletion proportionate to it.

nodes.label: SongCatalogController Instrumentation
nodes.rationale: One root trace (song_catalog.refresh) with five nested spans (membership resolve, session verify, list songs, fetch sources batch, write snapshot); no repository/store dependencies injected; wrapping at call site, not in constructors; controller owns all instrumentation.

nodes.label: SongCatalogController Local-First Reads
nodes.rationale: Implements D3 offline-authenticated entry path; establishes context from LastKnownIdentity when local snapshot exists in sessionExpired state; independent of D2 session-mapping fix; read path itself no longer depends on expiring auth state.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Ordering and Sentry Init
nodes.rationale: TracingHttpClient must exist before Supabase.initialize, which must run before ProviderScope; Observability singleton set by initObservability in bootstrap() before runApp; Sentry init runs without appRunner to keep Supabase/runApp failures loud; web supplies runBootstrapGuarded zone.
